title: Coach Summary
description: Best for concise narrative coaching feedback grounded in visible actions.
prompt_body: Write a short coach-style review of the boxing clip using only visible evidence. Keep the tone practical and beginner-friendly. Highlight the clearest strengths, the most obvious issues, and the next corrections that would help most. Do not guess hidden details or overstate uncertain observations. Separate the response into summary, strengths, issues, next steps, and notes.
